$comment: Tier-0 materials found in the world. These are the ONLY materials with a hand-authored elementComposition; everything craftable derives its composition from its recipe inputs at build time (see tools/build-content.mjs).

materials.name: Stick
materials.description: A length of fallen branch. The humblest possible input, and the base of half of everything.

materials.name: Stone
materials.description: Grey river rock, cold and dense. Holds an edge badly and a grudge well.

materials.name: Plant Fiber
materials.description: Stringy inner bark, stripped and dried. Weak alone, stubborn in numbers.

materials.name: Flint
materials.description: Dark, glassy nodule that fractures into edges. Strikes sparks against its own kind.

materials.name: Clay
materials.description: Wet grey earth that remembers whatever shape you last gave it.

materials.name: Spring Water
materials.description: Cold and startlingly clear. Alchemists insist the source matters. It does.

materials.name: Glowcap
materials.description: A pale fungus that keeps a soft light for hours after picking. Nobody is sure why.

materials.name: Pine Resin
materials.description: Amber sap, tacky and sharp-smelling. Catches fire with enthusiasm.

materials.name: Bleached Bone
materials.description: Sun-whitened and hollow. Something walked here once, and stopped.

materials.name: Gale Moss
materials.description: Grows only on the windward face of things. Twitches when the air is still.

materials.name: Coal
materials.description: Compressed ancient forest. Burns long, dirty, and hot.

materials.name: Cinder Sand
materials.description: Fine black grit off the flats. Gets into absolutely everything.

materials.name: Obsidian
materials.description: Cooled too fast to become a proper rock. Edges sharper than any metal, and just as brittle.

materials.name: Ember Bloom
materials.description: A flower that grows in ash and runs hot to the touch. Wilts if it cools.

materials.name: Iron Ore
materials.description: Rust-streaked rock, far heavier than it looks. Useless until something melts it.

materials.name: Silver Ore
materials.description: Bright threads running through dull stone. Takes light well and holds a charge better.

materials.name: Crystal Shard
materials.description: Grown, not formed. Hums faintly when another shard comes near.

materials.name: Voidglass
materials.description: Black glass that does not reflect you. Cold in any weather.

materials.name: Aetherdust
materials.description: Scraped from the rim where the maelstrom grinds the world thin. Drifts upward if you let go.
